files.description: Registered EHI export documentation PDF (v8.0). Single page with MDFlow logo and 5 bullet points describing the export: C-CDA as primary format, CSV/PDF for custom requests, single or group patient export, ZIP compression. No data dictionary or field-level detail.
Supplemental EHI B10 export documentation PDF (v8.1). Single page clarifying the export is a ZIP containing per-encounter C-CDA ZIP archives. No data dictionary or field-level detail.

FHIR API documentation for (g)(7)/(g)(9)/(g)(10) certification. 58 pages covering SMART on FHIR auth, individual FHIR R4 resource endpoints (US Core/USCDI v1 set), and patient search. This is the standardized API documentation, not the (b)(10) EHI export, but provides context on what clinical data the system exposes via FHIR.
FHIR Bundle containing Endpoint and Organization resources listing the FHIR server base URLs. This is a (g)(10) Service Base URL artifact, not directly related to EHI export.
Full-page screenshot of the MDFlow mandatory disclosures / product page showing the EHI export links, certified criteria list, and product description.
